en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear. 'Изгор' is a guess: I read it as 'burning, torment' used as an endearment. 'Лено, Ленче' are forms of the name Lena.

lines.cyr: Еј, за кого ти се тие црни очи,
lines.lat: Ej, za kogo ti se tie crni oči,
lines.en: Hey, for whom are those black eyes of yours,

lines.cyr: за кого ти се тие медни усни?
lines.lat: za kogo ti se tie medni usni?
lines.en: for whom are those honey lips of yours?
Lena, Lenche, come on, tell me,
don't let my heart burn up.
Lena, Lena, Lenche, mother's little girl,

lines.cyr: Сè што сакаш, Ленче, тебе ќе ти дадам,
lines.lat: Sè što sakaš, Lenče, tebe ḱe ti dadam,
lines.en: Everything you want, Lenche, I will give you,

lines.cyr: коси да ти милувам, на гради да те успивам.
lines.lat: kosi da ti miluvam, na gradi da te uspivam.
lines.en: I will caress your hair, I will lull you to sleep on my chest.

lines.cyr: Еј, крај твоите порти стројници се редат,
lines.lat: Ej, kraj tvoite porti strojnici se redat,
lines.en: Hey, by your gate the match-makers line up,

lines.cyr: под твојот прозор ергени ти пеат.
lines.lat: pod tvojot prozor ergeni ti peat.
lines.en: under your window bachelors sing to you.

lines.cyr: Лено, Ленче, изгор мој, само јас ќе бидам твој,
lines.lat: Leno, Lenče, izgor moj, samo jas ḱe bidam tvoj,
lines.en: Lena, Lenche, my torment, only I will be yours,

lines.cyr: Лено, Ленче, ангел мој, само јас ќе бидам твој.
lines.lat: Leno, Lenče, angel moj, samo jas ḱe bidam tvoj.
lines.en: Lena, Lenche, my angel, only I will be yours.
Lena, Lena, Lenche, mother's little girl,
